translations.web: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
translations.bsb: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
translations.kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
translations.asv: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression: They speak loftily.
